title: Greek Pilaf with Lentils
description: A hearty and nutritious pilaf dish made with lentils, perfect for lunch. This recipe combines the flavors of Greece with the comfort of a warm pilaf.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the uncooked rice and stir to coat in oil. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the cooked lentils, Greek pilaf seasoning, and 2 cups of water to the saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
